solutions.title: Flattened inorder list
solutions.strategy: Traverse the tree once at construction time and store all values in sorted order.

timeComplexity.explanation: The constructor visits every node once. Each later operation reads or advances an array index.

spaceComplexity.explanation: All node values are stored in an inorder list.

solutions.title: Controlled inorder stack
solutions.strategy: Keep only the path to the next smallest node, pushing left descendants lazily after each pop.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each tree node is pushed and popped once across the full iteration, so total next work is O(n) for n calls.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores at most one root-to-leaf path, where h is tree height.
